posts.name: Undead_Octopus
posts.cooked:
Hey guys, long time player of SotM: The Video Game, first time poster. I've most likely played with alot of you via my ids of Undead 0ctopus or Reptilian Ghoul!

I'm having some major issues and I know the team is busy with Vengance and what not so I didn't want to post here but when the new update dropped and these bugs were unfixed I realize I had to post. I'm having a major bug issue with my game, here is some information.

 

No Music at all. Via Multiverse info tabs or in game enviroment sound. I do have full effect sound though. :broken_heart:

 
  • I use an iPhone 5C with its current iOs update to play.
  • I have all the DLC for the game including the foil pack.
  • I have my music and effects turned all the way up.
  • I do not have any other apps open on my phone.
  • My mute switch on my phone is not toggled.
  • All other downloaded apps/games give me both music and sound effects besides SotM: The Video Game.
  • I have uninstalled all DLC and reinstalled.
  • I have uninstalled the game and reinstalled via computer link.
  • Also whenever I hit the "Skip" reccomendation on someones turn it just keep looping the sound constantly.
 

This has been happening since the previous update and the current one didnt fix it. I really miss the music of Jean Marc, I go to all the listening parties you all have too so you can imagine my pain, the other stuff is just minor at this point. I hope I posted this is the correct section. I really enjoy your game and the players, keep up the good work GtG, hopefully you can help me out with this!
